d: Germany's Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul has expressed shock over US President Donald Trump's reported intervention in Nvidia's leadership, questioning whether political pressure on private companies sets a precedent for the future. Speaking at a forum in Berlin, Wadephul said he had rarely witnessed such direct political involvement in a company's affairs, warning that governments in democratic, rules-based countries should refrain from interfering in business decisions.
